panels.title: Indoor Temperature — Haven (return-air mix) vs Thermostat (wall)
panels.description: Haven measures return air temperature in the duct. Thermostat reports wall-sensor temperature. Bias = thermostat is in a warmer/cooler spot than the house mixed average.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haven.indoor" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0, _field: "Haven return-air °F" }))

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac.thermostat" and r._field == "indoor_temp_f")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Thermostat wall °F" }))

panels.title: Indoor Relative Humidity — Haven (return mix) vs Thermostat (wall)
panels.description: Haven RH in return duct vs thermostat humidity sensor. Return air RH is the actual latent load the system has to remove.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haven.indoor" and r._field == "humidity")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Haven return-air %RH" }))

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac.thermostat" and r._field == "humidity_pct")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Thermostat wall %RH" }))

panels.title: Bias: Thermostat minus Haven (positive = thermostat reads warmer than house mix)
panels.description: Sustained positive bias means your thermostat lives in a hot spot; sustained negative means a cool spot. Diurnal swings (sun on the wall) show as periodic patterns.

targets.query:
haven = from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haven.indoor" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

stat = from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac.thermostat" and r._field == "indoor_temp_f")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

join(tables: { h: haven, s: stat }, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value_s - r._value_h, _field: "bias_thermostat_minus_haven_f" }))

panels.title: Blower Activity — Haven Airflow vs Refoss em:9 (blower circuit W)
panels.description: Cross-validation: where Haven shows airflow > 0, the blower circuit (Refoss em:9) should show non-trivial watts. Declining airflow trend over weeks indicates filter loading.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "haven.indoor" and r._field == "airflow")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Haven Airflow" }))

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and r.channel == "em:9")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Furnace Blower W" }))
